summary: MSME status determination pre-insolvency; applicability of Section 29(A)(e) disqualification; interpretation of Bafna Pharmaceuticals precedent; 'exceptional circumstances' requirement for MSME promoters to bypass competitive bidding; CoC's authority to evaluate resolution plans; contempt proceedings arising from misinterpretation of prior judgment; NCLAT order set aside for failing to consider contextual limitations of Bafna case; two-month OTS window granted to respondent No.1.
legal_provisions_cited: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 s.29A(c), s.29A(h)
Kunhayammed & Ors vs State Of Kerala & Anr. (2000)6 SCC 359
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; NCLAT judgment set aside; contempt proceedings quashed; respondent No.1 granted two-month window for OTS negotiation with financial creditors under strict conditions.
